# MANUFACTURING CHECK - SIH26113 Maternity Assist Belt

Every item the brief asks to check before declaring the design complete, with the value the files actually contain. Measured figures come from `validate_drc.py` re-reading the emitted `.brd`; assumptions are labelled as such.

> **No fabricator capability is assumed as verified.** The numbers below are what the board *requires*. Item 7 is the one that has to be checked against a specific fab's quoted capability before ordering - see `REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION.md` H6.

| # | Item | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PCB dimensions | **100 x 70 mm** (70 cm2) | set in `design.py`, outline on layer 20 |
| 2 | Board thickness | **1.6 mm** FR-4 | **assumption** - standard; dielectric split 0.36 / 0.71 / 0.36 mm declared in the rule set |
| 3 | Layer count | **4** - `(1*2*15*16)`; L2 = GND plane, L15 = 3V3 plane | verified in the `.brd` design rules |
| 4 | Copper thickness | **1 oz (35 um)** outer and inner | **assumption** - drives the trace-width calculation in `POWER_BUDGET.md` |
| 5 | Via sizes | drill **0.3 mm**, pad 0.55-0.60 mm | 486 vias, all through (`extent 1-16`) |
| 6 | Minimum trace width | **0.15 mm** (fine-pitch escapes); 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.5 mm in use | measured from the emitted tracks |
| 7 | Minimum clearance | **0.130 mm measured anywhere on the board** | 0.15 mm general rule; 0.127 mm inside the 4 declared fine-pitch fan-outs. **Needs a fab quoting 5 mil / 0.127 mm** |
| 8 | Drill sizes | vias 0.3 mm; plated pads 0.8, 1, 2.2 mm | JST PH 0.8 mm is within JST's ø0.7 +0.1 spec; M2 holes 2.2 mm |
| 9 | Component courtyard | **no overlaps**, 0.9 mm minimum gap between courtyards | DRC rule D2, enforced by the placement pass |
| 10 | Connector accessibility | 12 of 18 connectors are on a board edge; see the table below | the 6 interior ones all take a flying lead from an off-board transducer |
| 11 | Antenna keep-out | **20 x 6.6 mm** at the top edge, flush | no pad, via or track inside it (DRC rule D3); both plane polygons are drawn as an L that omits it |
| 12 | Mounting holes | **4 x M2**, 2.2 mm drill, 4.4 mm plated annulus on GND | `H3` is at (2.6, 42) not the top-left corner, because that corner is inside the antenna keep-out |
| 13 | Assembly feasibility | see the assembly table below | **3 parts need a stencil and reflow / hot air**; everything else is hand-solderable |
| 14 | Component availability | **NOT VERIFIED** | distributor stock could not be checked from this environment. `BOM.csv` carries empty Supplier / Supplier PN / Lifecycle columns rather than invented ones |
| 15 | Polarity markings | diodes and LEDs carry a silkscreen cathode bar; pad 1 = cathode on every 2-pin polarised footprint | in the library |
| 16 | Pin 1 markings | silkscreen dot or chamfer on every multi-pin part; **pad 1 is square** on every through-hole connector | in the library |
| 17 | Silkscreen readability | reference designators at 0.8-1.1 mm vector text | **assumption** - most fabs hold 0.8 mm with a 0.15 mm stroke; confirm, see `REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION.md` L3 |
| 18 | Solder-paste / stencil | **required** | order the stencil with the boards - see item 13 |

## Connector accessibility (item 10)

| Edge | Connectors |
|---|---|
| bottom (y < 6 mm) | J14, J15, J2, J4, J8 |
| left (x < 6 mm) | J1, J3, J5 |
| right (x > 94 mm) | J17, J7 |
| top (y > 64 mm) | J16, J18 |
| interior | J10, J11, J12, J13, J6, J9 |

The interior connectors are the four FSR headers (`J9`-`J12`), the stretch-sensor header (`J13`) and the optional second AS5600 (`J6`). All six take a flying lead from a transducer mounted on the belt, so none of them needs a board edge - and putting the FSR headers in a vertical row inboard, rather than a long horizontal row along the edge, was deliberate: a row of through-hole pads across the board is a wall through both signal layers. See `DESIGN_ASSUMPTIONS.md` 14.

## Assembly feasibility (item 13)

| Method | Placements |
|---|---|
| hand-solderable | 146 |
| reflow / hot air only | 3 |
| reflow or hot air (castellated) | 1 |

The three parts that cannot be soldered with an iron are the **AD8232** (0.5 mm-pitch QFN with a 2.50 mm exposed pad), the **LSM6DSOX** (0.5 mm LGA) and the **TMP117** (0.65 mm WSON with a thermal pad).

Tallest part: **J9 at 8.5 mm** above the board, so the minimum internal enclosure height is about 11.6 mm including the substrate and a little clearance.

**Keep the battery and any metal at least 10 mm from the antenna region** (top edge, x 9-29 mm). A Li-Po pack laid against it will cost most of the radio range.
